_comment: Accepted high/critical advisories in the API's NuGet packages. Read by scripts/audit-nuget.js, which runs in CI. Same rules as .audit-allowlist.json: every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the build fails once reviewBy passes, and again if the entry stops matching anything. Do not add an entry to silence a finding that has a usable patched version - upgrade instead.

allow.reason: CVE-2026-114147 (ASP.NET Core DoS), published 2026-11-11. Only fix on the 8.0 line is 8.0.34, published 2026-11-10 13:11 UTC and still inside the repo's 72h install cooldown. Bump every Microsoft 8.0.33 reference to 8.0.34 once it clears (2026-11-13 13:11 UTC) and delete this entry.
